themes.title: Populist Right Momentum Ahead of Elections
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties are capitalizing on incumbent vulnerabilities and social crises to register historic polling gains across Europe and South America. From Vox exploiting infrastructure failures in Spain and Frp achieving record polling in Norway to the Rassemblement National dominating French presidential surveys and the AfD maintaining strong leads in Germany, conservative populist movements are framing themselves as the sole viable alternative to establishment governance.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Capitalizing on railway infrastructure scandals to project historic polling numbers alongside PP, reaching potential absolute majority thresholds.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Reaching record high polling support of 32.2%, eclipsing traditional conservative rivals in Norway.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen leads national trust and presidential polling for 2027, consolidating support among youth and former centrist voters.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Maintaining dominant positions in eastern German state polls and holding strong nationally despite bipartisan pushback.

themes.title: Judicial Crackdowns and Surveillance Targeting the Far-Right
themes.blurb: Right-wing figures and party organizations across multiple jurisdictions are mounting aggressive defenses against state investigations, judicial mandates, and intelligence oversight. From Flávio Bolsonaro fleeing to the United States to evade Supreme Court sanctions in Brazil to Polish PiS leaders clashing with law enforcement over the Constitutional Tribunal, right-wing leaders portray judicial institutions as politicized tools of left-leaning regimes.

countries.name: 🇧🇷 Bolsonarismo / Partido Liberal
countries.note: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro appeals Supreme Court restrictions and passport seizures while seeking refuge in the US amid money laundering inquiries.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS politicians and President Karol Nawrocki accuse Donald Tusk's administration of illegal force and state aggression surrounding the Constitutional Tribunal.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen intervenes in Poland's judicial conflict while RN faces petition-driven threats to allied media outlets and office vandalism.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD faces disqualifications from local mayoral races, court bans on protest gear, and email leak investigations.

themes.title: National Priority Rhetoric and Hardline Migration Demands
themes.blurb: Conservative and far-right parties are intensifying calls for national priority policies, stricter citizenship rules, and immediate curbs on asylum and migration. Party leaders in the UK, Spain, Norway, and Sweden are framing immigration as an existential threat to national identity, public finances, and security, demanding systemic legal overhauls.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Nigel Farage demands citizenship revocation for non-contributing migrants and strict border enforcement.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Promotes national priority economic proposals, opposes municipal immigrant reception funding, and demands territorial protection.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Opposes government integration plans, advocating for over 30 strict immigration policy rollbacks.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Debates strict citizenship criteria and definitions of Swedishness within public discourse.

themes.title: Internal Coalition Friction Over Foreign Policy and Media Strategy
themes.blurb: Governing right-wing alliances and conservative coalitions are experiencing heightened friction over budget priorities, foreign military aid, media outlets, and leadership authority. Clashes in Italy over pension reforms and Ukraine support mirror governing deadlocks in Sweden and internal strategic disputes within Argentina's ruling bloc.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Matteo Salvini's Lega clashes with Meloni over pension reform, budget allocations, and blocking Ukraine military aid.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Friction over coalition government formation and cabinet seats, alongside internal rows over party-linked media outlets.

themes.title: Far-Right Election Contestation Following Brazilian Runoff Defeat
themes.blurb: Repercussions from past electoral defeats continue to fuel cross-border legal challenges, rhetoric around election integrity, and political asylum dynamics. Brazilian leaders defend high-profile exits following electoral defeats while US conservative leaders deploy observers and legal filings to preemptively contest mail-in balloting.

countries.name: 🇧🇷 Bolsonarismo / Partido Liberal
countries.note: Defense of Flávio Bolsonaro's flight to the US linked to post-election defeat fallout and Supreme Court pressure.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump administration deploys 1,000 election monitors and mounts legal challenges to mail-in ballots ahead of midterms.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Milei administration clarifies position on Brazilian political figures crossing borders post-election.
